VWR (part of [Avantor](https://corporate.avantorsciences.com/pr/en/brands/vwr)) provides an extensive catalog of over millions of laboratory and industrial science products. Their core offerings span general laboratory consumables, analytical chemicals, life science reagents, heavy equipment, and safety supplies utilized across biotechnology, pharmaceutical, and educational sectors. [](https://www.vwr.com/us/en/products)

- **Laboratory Consumables:** Nitrile and latex gloves, serological and transfer pipettes, pipette tips, petri dishes, centrifuge tubes, and wipes.

- **Chemicals & Solvents:** Acids, salts, high-purity solvents, reagents, and analytical standards (including BDH® chemicals).

- **Equipment & Instruments:**

Water baths, hot plates, stirrers, centrifuges, balances, incubators, ovens, and refrigerators.

- **Controlled Environment & Safety:** Cleanroom apparel, face masks, bin liners, biohazard bags, and personal protective equipment (PPE).

- **Furniture & Fluid Management:** Modular lab benches, seating, storage cabinets, and peristaltic tubing systems. [](https://www.vwr.com/us/en/products)
